name: data-grid
title: Data grid
description: The table people work in: sort, resize, pin and hide columns, edit cells in place, and save views.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: The row's id, for selection, edits and React keys. Defaults to `row.id`.

props.name: label
props.description: The grid's accessible name.

props.name: rowLabel
props.description: Names a row for its select checkbox ("Select Ada Okafor"). Defaults to the first column's text, else the row's number.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Leave rows in the order given (sort them yourself in onSortChange).

props.name: selectable
props.description: A checkbox column; `selection` holds the picked rows' ids.

props.name: columnVisibility
props.description: Column key → shown. A key that's left out shows.

props.name: columnOrder
props.description: Column keys in the order to show them; keys left out follow in `columns` order. Pinned columns keep their edge.

props.name: columnSizing
props.description: Column key → width in px; a key that's left out takes the column's `width`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height: 40 (`default`) or 32 (`compact`).

props.name: onCellEdit
props.type: (rowId: string, key: string, value: unknown) => unknown
props.description: Called with an edited cell's new value; update `rows` with it. Return a promise and the cell shows a Spinner until it settles, or an error if it rejects (its message is shown).

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton rows in place of the body.

props.name: error
props.description: The rows failed to load: a message (or `true` for the default one) in place of the body.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Try again on the error state.

props.name: filtered
props.description: The rows are filtered: with none left, the grid says No results instead of empty.

props.name: onClearFilters
props.description: Shows Clear filters on the No results state.

props.name: empty
props.description: What shows when there are no rows (not filtered). Defaults to an EmptyState with a table icon.

props.name: noResults
props.description: What shows when `filtered` leaves no rows. Defaults to an EmptyState with a search icon, "No results" and, with `onClearFilters`, Clear filters. Pass your own to name the search.

props.name: virtualize
props.description: Draw only the rows on screen. Defaults to on above 200 rows.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page, with a Pagination under the grid. Left out, every row is in one scrolling body.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, from 1.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Above the grid: `DataGridToolbar` with search, filters, `DataGridColumnsMenu`, `DataGridViewMenu`.

DataGridToolbar.description: A row above the grid for search, filters and the menus. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

DataGridColumnsMenu.description: The Columns menu: a switch per column (a column with `hideable: false` stays on), Alt with ↑ or ↓ moves the highlighted column, and Reset columns brings back every column in its first order and width. Other props, `ref` included, go to the trigger Button.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger's text. Defaults to the `dataGridColumns` label ("Columns").

DataGridViewMenu.description: The saved-views menu: pick a view to put the grid in its sort, columns and filters; save the grid as it is as a new view (a dialog asks for the name), save changes to the view in use, or delete it. A Dot on the trigger marks unsaved changes. Other props, `ref` included, go to the trigger Button.

props.name: views
props.description: The saved views.

props.name: onViewsChange
props.description: Called with the new list after a save, an update or a delete.

props.name: value
props.description: The view in use, by id; null for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (id: string | null, view: DataGridView<F> | null) => void
props.description: Called when a view is picked or saved, after the grid takes its sort and columns: apply its `filters` here.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filters in use, saved with a new view and compared to tell a view has unsaved changes.
